message: 流星町消滅!?

name: Synn
message: 「This is the end!」
The attack we unleashed shattered every single shield of light deployed before her and struck the witch dead on!

name: Soltia
message: 「Aaaaaahhh!」
Yet, even now, the witch still wouldn't fall.
Even though her entire body was covered in wounds from our attacks and the overload of using magic continuously.

name: Misa
message: 「How!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「S-She doesn't know when to give up!」
Looking like a wraith, she thrust her arm out toward us.

name: Ria
message: 「You still intend to keep fighting!?」
Flickering like a dying neon sign, light began gathering in her arm.
However,
At last, along with the light, her arm itself began to melt and crumble away.

name: Soltia
message: 「It seems... this is... as far as I go...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like her magic's started going out of control.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, then, don't tell me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-Is she going to explode!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nah. She doesn't have enough durability left to cause an explosion that'd take the town with her. Her magic's just gonna completely devour everything, right down to her soul.」
Just as thin streaks of light began leaking out from Soltia's body in all directions,
Her arms vanished, followed by her legs, and then her torso faded away.
Speechless, we watched the process of her disappearance.

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't give me that long face, Demon Lord. Even if we'd lost, she'd have ended up like this anyway. Would've been a whole lot flashier, though.」
Even though she's the very person who put Nanaka through all that, why am I feeling like this?
Probably because I felt like things with Soltia could never have ended any other way.
Misa took a step forward.

name: Misa
message: 「Sensei... I liked your classes.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Is that so... I didn't... dislike them either... teaching...」

name: Misa
message: 「Why... did things end up like this...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Doing this... was my only... hope...」
She vanished.
Soltia--no, Sengen'in-sensei--quietly vanished, like morning mist bathed in sunlight.
